style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Padded Candy Cane Stripe Bow Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Add a playful festive touch to your seasonal décor with this 140cm padded candy cane stripe bow garland. Featuring soft, generously filled bows in a classic red and white candy cane stripe, it captures the joyful spirit of Christmas while adding a stylish decorative finish to your home. The padded design gives each bow a full, luxurious shape, creating a striking sense of depth and texture whether displayed along a mantelpiece, staircase, doorway or festive table setting. The bold striped pattern brings a cheerful, nostalgic feel that pairs beautifully with both traditional and contemporary Christmas themes. At 140cm in length, this garland offers excellent coverage while remaining flexible and easy to style, allowing you to drape or position it exactly as you wish. The vibrant red and crisp white tones stand out beautifully against greenery, lights and metallic accents, helping you create a coordinated and eye-catching festive display. Perfect for adding a whimsical yet elegant finishing touch, this padded candy cane stripe bow garland is a delightful way to brighten your home and celebrate the magic of the season year after year. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: 140cm.
